title: Black Leather Wallet
description: Hi po, naiwan ko yung black leather wallet ko around cafeteria 2nd floor after lunch. May student ID at konting cash inside, tapos may initials na 'JB' sa harap.

title: Blue Hydroflask Water Bottle
description: Saw this blue Hydroflask sa bench near library entrance around 10am. May stickers pa, looks like someone forgot it after class.

title: Silver MacBook Charger
description: This is to report a found item: one silver Apple MacBook charger (USB-C, 67W), recovered in IT Building Room 301 after the afternoon session.

description: Help huhu, nawala yung Honda car keys ko sa Parking Lot B. Naka-Honda keychain siya and may maliit na flashlight na nakasabit.

title: Red Notebook with Notes
description: Good day. I found a red spiral notebook with handwritten Computer Science notes in Lecture Hall A. Walang name sa cover, but mukhang important yung laman.
